case_metadata.drug_detail: 2.5 mg/0.5 mL subcutaneous once weekly, starting dose with titration
case_metadata.policy_pathway: V. Zepbound — 1. Weight Loss in an Adult with Overweight or Obesity — A) Initial Therapy
case_metadata.design_note: The only post-denial case in the dataset. The denial was correct on the record it had; the qualifying trial existed but its records were held by an outside programme and were retrieved five weeks later. The expected position is reconsideration with the new evidence, not a challenge to the original determination, and a system that treats the later-obtained records as though the payer should have seen them is getting the timing wrong.

denial_ground_truth.denial_reason_text: The submitted record documents approximately seven weeks of dietary and behavioral intervention, short of the required three months.
denial_ground_truth.cited_policy_reference: Cigna National Formulary Coverage Policy, "Weight Loss – Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Agonists Prior Authorization Policy," V. Zepbound, 1. Weight Loss in an Adult with Overweight or Obesity, A) Initial Therapy
denial_ground_truth.cited_requirement_text: Patient has engaged in a trial of behavioral modification and dietary restriction for at least 3 months
records_reviewed_at_denial: Internal medicine office note dated 2026-04-06, covering this clinic's records only

criteria.interpretation_note: The policy states a minimum duration and does not state that the trial must be continuous or that it must be recent. The Northside block alone runs 06/09/2025 to 10/20/2025, 133 days, and satisfies the duration on its own terms without needing to be aggregated with the later block.

scope_notes: The trial criterion sets no recency requirement, so a completed 2025 programme counts. This should not be extended to policies that do state recency; the Cigna MASH pathway, for example, sets explicit time windows for its diagnostic tests.

evidence_ground_truth.evidence_timing_note: The Northside Metabolic Program records existed throughout but were held by an outside provider and were obtained in 05/2026, five weeks after the determination. They were not available to the payer, to the prescriber, or in the clinic chart at the time of the 04/06/2026 submission. The patient had mentioned an earlier programme without being able to name or date it.

expected_evidence.evidence_text: Northside Metabolic Program records: enrolment 06/09/2025 with dietitian-led calorie restriction, fortnightly review, weekly behavioural group and a supervised exercise component; discharge summary 10/20/2025 recording completion with good attendance. That block runs 133 days. This clinic's programme from 02/16/2026 adds dietitian appointments on 03/16/2026 and 05/04/2026.
expected_evidence.evidence_location: SUBJECTIVE; TREATMENT AND PROGRAMME HISTORY, 06/09/2025 and 10/20/2025 entries

expected_evidence.evidence_text: Height 6 ft 0 in with 247 lb (BMI 33.5) on 02/16/2026, 244 lb (BMI 33.1) on 04/06/2026 and 242 lb (BMI 32.8) on 05/18/2026. The Northside file additionally reports 251 lb at enrolment in 06/2025, reproduced as reported.
DOB 09/30/1988; age 37 at the time of the request.
Plan item 1 continues the dietitian's plan and the cycling alongside the medication.

missing_evidence.description: At the time of the original submission, no record of the 2025 programme existed in the clinic chart. The patient's unsupported statement that he had 'done a programme before', without a name or dates, was the only trace.

sufficiency_ground_truth.sufficiency_note: Sufficient on the complete record as it now stands. Not sufficient on the record before the payer at the time of the determination, which is why the expected position is reconsideration rather than challenge.

per_criterion.reason: The Northside programme ran 06/09/2025 to 10/20/2025, 133 days, and is documented by enrolment and discharge records. Satisfied on the complete record; not established on the record available at denial.
Dietitian plan and cycling to continue alongside the drug.

supported_claims: The Northside Metabolic Program records document a 133-day structured trial of behavioral modification and dietary restriction from June to October 2025.
Those records were held by an outside provider and were not available to the prescriber or the payer at the time of the original submission.
The remaining criteria — age, baseline BMI and concomitant lifestyle measures — were satisfied on the original submission and are not in dispute.
unsupported_claims: That the payer erred on the record before it; the determination was correct on what was submitted.
That the member's own clinic documented a three-month trial at the time of the request.
That the two blocks of intervention were continuous.
appeal_ground_truth.correct_next_step: Submit the Northside enrolment record and discharge summary with a reconsideration request, framed as new evidence rather than as an error by the reviewer. Do not argue that the original determination was wrong on the record available.

facts_allowed_in_appeal: The Northside Metabolic Program records document enrolment on June 9, 2025 and discharge on October 20, 2025.
That programme comprised dietitian-led calorie restriction with fortnightly review, a weekly behavioural group, and a supervised exercise component.
The discharge summary records completion with good attendance, and the programme ended for non-clinical reasons.
The Northside records were obtained in May 2026 and were not previously available to this clinic.
A dietitian consultation at the treating clinic began on February 16, 2026, with reviews on March 16, 2026 and May 4, 2026.
Documented BMI on May 18, 2026 was 32.8 kg/m2, with height 6 feet 0 inches and weight 242 pounds.
The member was 37 years of age at the time of the request.
facts_not_allowed_in_appeal: The Northside records were submitted with the original prior authorization request.
The payer had access to the Northside records at the time of the determination.
The member's intervention has been continuous since June 2025.
The treating clinic documented a three-month trial before April 6, 2026.
The member has type 2 diabetes or another listed weight-related comorbidity.
The member failed a trial of another anti-obesity agent.
